questions.q: What does the AZ-900 exam actually test?
options: Only compliance frameworks like GDPR and HIPAA
Understanding of cloud concepts, core Azure services, and governance/pricing at a conceptual level — not hands-on engineering skill
The ability to write a complete Bicep file from memory
Advanced database administration techniques
questions.explain: AZ-900 doesn't require writing code or running CLI commands from memory — it tests whether you understand what these things are and why they exist.

questions.q: Which chapter of this course maps most directly to the exam's "Azure management and governance" area?
options: Chapter 1 — Cloud & Azure Concepts
Chapter 2 — Core Azure Services
Chapter 4 — Working in Azure
Chapter 3 — Security, Pricing & Governance
questions.explain: RBAC, pricing and cost tools, Policy, tags, management groups, and compliance all live in Chapter 3.

questions.q: What is the format of the AZ-900 exam?
options: A coding interview focused on writing ARM templates
An open-book take-home exam with no time limit
A hands-on lab exam requiring you to deploy real Azure resources
A proctored, multiple-choice/multiple-select exam, roughly 40-60 questions, about an hour, with no lab component
questions.explain: There's no code to write and no lab component — it's a concept-focused, proctored, multiple-choice exam.

questions.q: According to this lesson, which courses in this catalog assume the foundation this course provides?
options: Azure Database Administrator and Data Factory
Only the Blockchain Development course
No other course in the catalog builds on this one
Only Advanced Databricks
questions.explain: Both Azure Database Administrator (DP-300 prep) and Data Factory assume you already know what a resource group, RBAC, and the Portal are.

questions.q: Does completing this course complete any career path in this catalog?
options: No — it's a prerequisite foundation for courses inside the Azure Database Administrator path, but that path itself isn't complete yet
Yes, it completes every Azure-flavored path in the catalog
It completes the path only if paired with PowerShell Fundamentals
Yes, it fully completes the Azure Database Administrator career path by itself
questions.explain: This course closes out Azure Fundamentals itself, but the Azure Database Administrator path it feeds into is not fully built yet.
